title: The Day of Two Conversations at Once
skyStory: The moon has rolled out of its Taurus hammock and tumbled into Gemini, the sign of twins, gossip and talking with your mouth full. It is still only two percent lit, but it's already chatting with everyone. Mars has been told the same secret twice by two different stars. Saturn has started taking minutes, in triplicate.

reading: Gemini moon plus Life Path 3 is a lot of talking. Delightful talking. You will be the person in every room who connects two people who should have met years ago. Somebody will say, wait, how do you know everyone? Shrug mysteriously.

The catch is that your attention will split like a river around a rock. Halfway through one sentence you will start another. The [[Two of Wands]] wants you holding two plans with steady hands, not juggling seven. When you catch yourself starting a third thing, finish the first. Out loud. Even if it's just to the kettle.
joel.mission: Introduce two people today, in person or by message, who you think would really like each other.
joel.omen: Two crows arguing on a fence. Someone's about to ask you to settle a debate; pick the funnier side.

reading: You will hear the same piece of news from two different directions today, and the versions won't match. Delicious. The Wood Rat loves a discrepancy. You'll spot exactly where the story bent and why.

Don't correct anyone. Just ask one gentle question that lets the truth float up on its own, like a bubble from the bottom of a tidal pool. It's a storyteller's trick and you're the best at it. Later, around 7, a friend will call with a story so long that you put the kettle on twice. Worth every minute.
nancy.mission: Tell the same short story to two different people today and notice which details you change.
nancy.omen: A bird singing two different songs from the same branch. Both versions are true; you don't have to choose.
nancy.elementWhy: let the stories flow around you

together.text: Play telephone with the universe. Joel sends Nancy a made-up headline about the cabin. Nancy sends one back about the shore. Each must reply with a follow-up story as if it were real news. The Gemini moon is reading over both your shoulders.

game.intro: Gemini moon means two of everything, including noise. Especially noise.
game.prompt: Two sounds from a busy kitchen happening at the same time, performed solo. The other guesses both.
